question: At the latest finalized Ethereum mainnet block when requested, what is the USDC paused() state at 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48, encoded as bytes32 with integer 1 for paused and 0 for unpaused?

definitions.window: The observation covers the last 1 hours ending at the latest finalized block available when requested. Resolve this once to inclusive fromBlock and toBlock; state reads use toBlock.
definitions.missing: If any required data is unavailable, inconsistent or incomplete, report inability; do not encode unknown as zero, false or an empty list.
definitions.call: Call paused() returning bool on the USDC proxy at toBlock. True maps to 1; false maps to 0.
definitions.encoding: Encode the unsigned integer as one bytes32: big-endian hexadecimal, 0x followed by exactly 64 hex digits, left-padded with zeros. Do not hash it or apply decimal scaling.
